title: Origin story: Yewheart
description: Yewheart was a bowyer who planted a yew grove and tended it for eighty years, and the oldest tree woke and spoke: it had watched archers for centuries and knew the perfect shot. Yewheart became the tree's archer, loosing arrows the yew itself guides — never missing, never killing unjustly.
